'''Carz''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in the [[Svivreni sector/Legends|Svivreni sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].

==Description==
This [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] a fluorescent blue-and-white [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] in the [[Carz system/Legends|Carz system]], an unimportant [[Star system/Legends|system]] most often referred to by its galactic coordinates.

==History==
The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Baron/Legends|baron]] [[Yorseg]] maintained a [[Yorseg's base|base]] on the moon, hidden deep within the rocky crust of the world. The natural [[Ore/Legends|ores]] helped hide the base from [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] scans.
